title: runtime channel vocabulary GLSL emitter emits unsigned preprocessor constants
body: The generated runtime rowless VoxelChannelVocabulary.glsl emits #define MAT_COUNT 0u; glslang rejects the unsigned suffix in #if MAT_COUNT > 0, so VIXEN needed a consumer-side semantic shim while preserving canonical generated output. The generator should emit a preprocessor-safe count or a generated conditional.

title: look-dev material roles still require declaration-order mapping
body: The runtime material table is correctly pack-owned and rowless in the consumer, but the existing look-dev Hull/HullAccent roles still need a hand-authored mapping to declaration-order row references because the facade has no role-to-material binding vocabulary. Consolidate role bindings into generated/content data.

title: VIXEN codegen witness requires absolute build root and target discovery
body: The documented codegen wrapper and target witness were not self-locating: the relative script was absent from the worktree root, the first absolute retry used the wrong build directory, and the look-dev target name differed from the guessed test target. The build facade should expose a stable root-aware check and target discovery contract.

title: EditorLayers schema changes require automatic ViewNounId regeneration
body: Adding the generated EditorLayers materials section left ViewNounId.g.h stale until the separate view_noun_enum_regen target was run. The schema-to-view build should wire dependent generated noun artifacts into the same regeneration/check transaction so a full build does not fail after a valid view schema edit.
